note: Adapted from the entry of Chhotani (1997) (211. Malaysiocapritermes keralai Chhotani and Ferry, Fig. 181; the original gives “In press. Chhotani and Ferry, Ann. Entom.”), originally in English; synonymy, figure numbers and distribution records are not translated. The book uses the genus name Malaysiocapritermes, whereas the site uses Procapritermes keralai Chhotani & Ferry, 1995; the type locality (Kerala, 5 km along the Kothamanglam—Munnar road) agrees, and the two are judged to be the same species under a different generic combination. The original records the alate as “Unknown”, so that caste is absent. The original notes that the soldier mandible “tips damaged” and that the terminal antennal segment is “probably broken”, and the measurements follow the original; “distal 114” is an OCR error and is translated as the anterior 1/4.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Colour and pilosity as in M. dakshinae. Total length about 5.50 mm. Head capsule subrectangular; the sides nearly straight; width slightly less than 3/4 of the head length to the mandibular base (length to mandibular base 1.65 mm, maximum width 1.20 mm, width/length index 0.725); the anterior 1/4 of the frons slopes steeply; the middle arm of the Y-shaped suture is visible only near the posterior margin of the head. Fontanelle transverse, its margin chitinized; situated at about 3/4 of the head length from the posterior margin (occiput–fontanelle distance 1.23 mm, occiput–fontanelle distance/head length index 0.745). Antennae with more than 13 segments (the terminal segment may be broken off); the segments long and slender; segment 3 longer than segment 2; segment 4 shortest. Labrum slightly asymmetrical; anterior margin incurved; the anterolateral angles projecting and angulate; the sides convex (length 0.27 mm, width 0.25 mm). Mandibles weakly asymmetrical, the apices damaged (left mandible length 1.83 mm, right 1.80 mm); slightly longer than the head (left mandible length/head length index 1.109); the posterior half of the outer margin of the left mandible wavy; the right mandible rod-like. Postmentum rod-shaped, the waist weakly incurved (length 0.80 mm, maximum width 0.35 mm, waist width 0.23 mm, waist width/maximum width index 0.657). Pronotum saddle-shaped (length 0.25 mm, width 0.65 mm); the middle of the anterior lobe weakly notched. Tibial apical spurs 3:2:2; the dorsal spur of the fore tibia weak but distinct.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Head capsule pale yellowish brown; legs and thorax pale yellow; postclypeus paler than the head; abdomen greyish because the gut contents show through. Head and body rather densely hairy. Head subcircular (length to the clypeal margin 0.90 mm, length to the mandibular base 0.65 mm, maximum width 0.77 mm). Fontanelle plate indistinct. Antennae 14-segmented; segment 3 shorter than segment 2; segment 4 shortest. Postclypeus arched, hairy; less than half as long as wide (length 0.14 mm, width 0.38 mm). Pronotum saddle-shaped (length 0.17 mm, width 0.40 mm); anterior margin without a notch. Tibial apical spurs 2:2:2; fore tibia much swollen; tarsi 4-segmented.
